You can find details in the following document: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1e1ZsFQYaBpHNoHI4ZHelJp1rkXgz-a9z9XGSVeUKgCc/edit?usp=sharing

The platform is available here: https://drepdao.176-102-64-240.sslip.io/

I created a round (ROUND 2) that is in the submission phase. You can submit a proposal. To do so: 1) Register as a submitter, 2) Wait for approval from the board, 3) Once approved, submit your proposal.
https://drepdao.176-102-64-240.sslip.io/?view=rounds&round=d1ab96be-e45f-456b-b8c1-69dfcb351b11

NOTE: I will do my best to watch the new requests. I approve anyone who is requesting to be a new submitter. If I do not respond in time (I can be with my kids on vacation), just contact me via email satucha@seznam.cz. 

After logging in with a Cardano wallet (Preprod), users can view all public info. Just use the link above and try it. 
I published the source code under the MIT license: https://github.com/innovation-and-growth-dao/platform
On the GitHub repo, you can find docs, architecture details, test report, etc.

I have shot the video. You can see me voting in Round 1 on a submitted funding proposal (submitted by Ivan big Submitter): https://youtu.be/1HbvzmRLaMs
You can find my vote as a regular viewer (you do not need to apply to be a DAO member or submitter).
